description: Writes a reply the person could send in one conversation, named by id, from the WhatsApp number’s AI assistant (its persona and knowledge) and that chat only, optionally steered by instruction. It reserves no AI conversation: it counts as one AI use in the workspace’s usage. On Starter, Growth and Scale, and on Free with a card, drafts carry on past the AI conversations the plan includes. It is refused while the workspace’s AI is paused: the AI conversations its plan includes are used up and no card lifts the limit (Free without a card, the 14-day trial, or a failed payment). The draft comes back as text, unsent. The draft is written from what the customer wrote and comes back marked untrusted.
